onboarding.introBody: One minute on how Tend works.

growth.title: Observations help you grow
growth.body: Tend is for professional development, not appraisal. There are no marks, averages or comparisons with colleagues. You see where a practice was seen and what to try next.

focus.title: You choose the focus
focus.body: Before each observation you pick what you would like feedback on, from your own goals.

reflect.title: You reflect first
reflect.body: AI helps your Centre Leader write notes, and your leader checks and approves every word before you see it. You share how it went before you read them, then agree or add context.

next.title: One next step you own
next.body: Every observation ends with one practical step, tips you can try tomorrow and a coach you can ask any time.

onboarding.roleBodyCentre: You are joining Tend as {role} at {centre}.
onboarding.roleWrong: Not right? Please ask your Tend admin to change it. You can still continue.
onboarding.noticeTitle: How Tend uses AI and your data
onboarding.noticeUpdatedTitle: We updated how Tend uses AI and your data
onboarding.noticeBody: Please read this before you start.

notice.purpose: Tend uses AI to transcribe observation notes, link them to the Quality Teaching Tool and draft growth notes and coaching tips. It is for professional development only, not for appraisal.
notice.gate: Nothing written by AI reaches an educator until a Centre Leader has checked and approved it.
notice.private: Private reflections are never shown to leaders. Leaders see only themes from coach chats, and if they open more detail it is logged.
notice.access: You can see who opened your records under Preferences.
notice.children: Children’s faces are blurred on the device before a photo is uploaded, and children’s names are replaced with “Child A” in growth notes.
notice.storage: Your data is stored in Singapore.

onboarding.noticeAck: I have read how Tend uses AI and my data.

home.title: Home
home.body: New growth notes from your Centre Leader appear here, with today’s “Try tomorrow” tip.

growth.title: My Growth
growth.body: Your plan: up to 3 goals, the level each was last seen at, and the evidence behind it.

reflect.title: Reflect
reflect.body: Jot down how a lesson went. You decide if an entry is private or shared; private entries are never shown to leaders.

coach.title: Coach
coach.body: Ask for ideas any time, by text or voice. Answers draw on your own goals and approved notes.

learn.title: Learn
learn.body: Ways to grow on each goal: a colleague to watch, internal sessions and courses, each with the reason it fits.

today.title: Today
today.body: What needs you: drafts to review, debriefs due, overdue observations, new shared reflections and plan items to endorse.

observe.title: Observe
observe.body: Schedule an observation, read the pre-brief, then capture with one tap: dictation, notes, photos and ★ moments.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.body: Check the AI draft beside its evidence. Nothing reaches the educator until you approve and share it.

educators.title: Educators
educators.body: Each educator’s plan, evidence timeline and growth over time on one page.

insights.title: Centre Insights
insights.body: Shared growth areas and blind spots across your centre, and a builder for learning groups.

network.title: Network
network.body: Growth areas across centres. Groups smaller than 5 people are hidden.
